    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in raw[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
i2,o2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
def f(g):
    R=len(g);C=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # detect wall orientation
    walls={(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==2}
    wall_cols={c for r,c in walls}; wall_rows={r for r,c in walls}
    shp=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    out=[[bg]*C for _ in range(R)]
    if len(wall_cols)==1:   # vertical wall col w -> slide horizontally toward it
        w=min(wall_cols)
        sc=min(c for r,c,_ in shp)
        if sc<=w: return [row[:] for row in g]
        d=sc-w-1
        for r,c,v in shp: out[r][c-d]=v
        for r in range(R): out[r][w]=2
        for r in range(R): out[r][max(c for r_,c,_ in shp)-d]=8
    elif len(wall_rows)==1:  # horizontal wall row wr -> slide vertically toward it
        wr=min(wall_rows)
        sr=min(r for r,c,_ in shp)
        if sr<=wr: return [row[:] for row in g]
        dv=sr-wr-1
        for r,c,v in shp: out[r-dv][c]=v
        for c in range(C): out[wr][c]=2
        for c in range(C): out[max(r for r,c,_ in shp)-dv][c]=8
    return out
print('demo2 ok:', f(i2)==o2)
T=G['Test input']; o=f(T)

    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(g):
    R=len(g);C=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    walls={(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==2}
    shp=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    out=[[bg]*C for _ in range(R)]
    wall_cols={c for r,c in walls}; wall_rows={r for r,c in walls}
    if len(wall_cols)==1:          # vertical wall col w -> slide right/left
        w=min(wall_cols); sc=min(c for r,c,_ in shp)
        if sc<=w: return [row[:] for row in g]
        d=sc-w-1                      # steps toward wall
        new_cmax=max(c for _,c,_ in shp)-d
        for r,c,v in shp: out[r][c-d]=v
        for r in range(R): out[r][w]=2                     # wall stays
        for r in range(R): out[r][new_cmax+1]=8
    else:                         # horizontal wall row wr -> slide up/down

        dv=sr-wr-1
        new_rmax=max(r for r,_,_ in shp)-dv
        for r,c,v in shp: out[r-dv][c]=v
        for c in range(C): out[wr][c]=2
        for c in range(C): out[new_rmax+1][c]=8
    return out
